title: Quadratic pair proof address
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number. This map sends a binary vector of length $n$ to the right summand, using its canonical binary-cube index in the first block of size $2^n$; it sends an $n\times n$ matrix over the field with two elements to the right summand, using the canonical index of its flattened entries in the second block of size $2^{n^2}$. The target is the disjoint union of a set of size $n$ and the proof-address set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$.
